title: Doodle Jump
shortDescription: Doodle Jump is grouped in GameAtlas's Nintendo 3DS family platformer catalog path beside a direct Wikidata structured-data record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced platformer option to the Nintendo 3DS family discovery path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Indexed for the Nintendo 3DS family platformer discovery path using the frozen Wikidata metadata snapshot; this remains a catalog entry with its source kept explicit.
